profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorganChase |  MSAI at UT Austin
profile.summary: Software Engineer specializing in data engineering and machine learning systems with experience building regulatory risk pipelines at JPMorgan and developing AI models using PyTorch and Hugging Face.

positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Collaborates with software engineers, business analysts and product owners to calculate credit exposures for Asset Wealth Management (AWM) Trades for the GAUSS calculator.

Key Accomplishments:
● Spearheading the integration of AWS S3 for automated market data ingestion and pricing information uploads using Python and cloud-native tools.
● Contributing to the design and implementation of pricing sensitivity models for Global Collateral Management (GCM) using Python, enhancing analytical capabilities. 
● Leading Agile Scrum practices by managing sprint tracking and backlog grooming through JIRA to improve team collaboration and delivery efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Key Accomplishments:
● Developing a robust CECL application within the GAUSS calculator ecosystem using Python, SQL, AWS Databricks, and Pandas to ingest upstream trade data, calculate exposures and shortfalls, and deliver results to downstream systems for validation.
● Conducting in-depth analysis of the Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL) aggregation process to map data flows, validate calculation logic, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards and documenting on Confluence
● Designing and maintaining a comprehensive project timeline to drive on-time delivery and effective task coordination across teams.
● Leading the execution of the Comprehensive Capital Analysis & Review (CCAR) workflow for Asset & Wealth Management (AWM) student portfolios, including stress value updates, full end-to-end test runs, and cross-functional support for technology and business stakeholders under tight deadlines.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Worked with a team to administer remote classroom instruction that includes extensive curriculum in full stack web development.

Key Accomplishments:
●	Improved students' understanding of course topics such as JavaScript and React by direct engagement.
●	Enriched students' coding abilities by providing immediate feedback on their code.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
Synchronized with sales staff, project managers, and architects to produce requested window design for residential apartments and commercial buildings using AutoCAD software

Key Accomplishments:
●	Improved fabrication rates and overall manufacturing process.
●	Increased client enthusiasm by providing drawings in a timely manner. 
●	Created 3D models of window cross sections for presentations and further understanding of products.

positions.title: Packaging Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Assisted Senior Packaging Engineer in all projects for Anna Sui and Dunhill.

Key Accomplishments:
●	Improved the specifications of perfume bottles using GD&T.
●	Increased functionality of the perfume product parts by reviewing CAD designs and revising dimensions if necessary.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
Assigned tasks and supervised and reported fiscal/personnel status to the management of the Pre-College Programs
Key Accomplishments:

●	Assisted in increasing the enrollment of participants in the Adelphi University Pre College Program.
●	Assisted in managing a successful Pre College Program for the summers of 2015 and 2016.

company.name: Adelphi University - Office of High School and Pre-College Programs

positions.title: Planetarium Intern
positions.description:
Researched and studied the propulsion system of the thrusters used for the New Horizons Spacecraft. 

Key Accomplishments:
●	Successfully monitored the path of the New Horizons Spacecraft and presented research.

projects.title: Gym Quest
projects.description: A fitness app created for those looking to start or add to their workout routines. Users are allowed to signup and login to use the site features such as workout categories, which are categorized by muscle group with a multitude of workouts available for each group. Users are also encouraged to comment on each workout.

projects.title: Space Sounds!
projects.description:
Space missions from companies such as NASA, SpaceX, Virgin Galactic and Blue Origin has made the desire to go to space increase exponentially over the past couple of years. We would like to make that dream realistic for everyone!

Please see GitHub repository for project: https://github.com/sarahhart1997/space-sounds
